name: Official
description: Repositories published by TypeSafe AI: SDKs, skills and reference resources that define how Jev is meant to be used.

name: SDKs & Clients
description: Client libraries and SDKs that wrap the Jev API for Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust and other stacks.

name: Integrations
description: Existing frameworks and tools with an optional, documented Jev path. The project works without Jev; the integration adds typed decisions.

name: Agent Tooling
description: Agent frameworks, routers, memory layers and tooling that use Jev to choose tools or branches.

name: Browser & Computer Use
description: Browser and desktop agents that read a page or screen and act on it, with Jev selecting the operation.

name: Applications
description: Complete applications where Jev makes a product decision: routing, ranking, classification or approval.

name: Games & Simulations
description: Games and simulations that use Jev as a player, policy or judge.

name: Demos & Playgrounds
description: Demos and playgrounds that show a Jev primitive with the smallest possible amount of code.

name: Benchmarks & Research
description: Benchmarks, replications, papers and independent alternatives that test or reproduce Jev behaviour.

name: Directories & Lists
description: Awesome lists and directories that index Jev projects. Useful for discovery, but they are not Jev applications themselves.
